actual_original300_new_costs.scope: All physical requests in original300 method namespaces, including retry rounds and superseded prefixes; historical seeded receipts and fresh60 requests are not charged here. Unreconciled reservations may include active requests.

project_and_global_budget.meaning: Known costs are returned-usage estimates recorded by the budget ledger; unknown liabilities remain reserved. Cache replays do not add ledger charges.

adoption_policy.source: User: 我们不追求F1的提升 只要不明显回退就作为可采取的简化
adoption_policy.adoption_objective: Simplify the workflow while avoiding material downstream regression; a positive F1 delta is not required.
report: paired final native F1 on identical queries
logical generation calls and input/output tokens
actual paid cost versus cached logical usage
adoption_policy.confirmation_selection_rule_role: The old highest-F1 rule selects one candidate for the fixed fresh60 comparison only; it is not an adoption gate and does not discard other viable simplifications.
adoption_policy.promotion: No version has been promoted from partial results; judge completed comparisons for practical simplicity and performance retention.

limits: Positive F1 gain is not required for a useful simplification.
No statistical nonsignificance is interpreted as equivalence or noninferiority.
Incomplete infrastructure cases are missing, not zero; algorithm failures count zero.
Bootstrap describes observed development queries and does not establish unseen generalization.
Matched full-success efficiency excludes incomplete or algorithm-aborted trajectories; their observed prefix costs remain in selected usage and the actual ledger.
Logical modeled cost counts cached generations at frozen identical rates; it is not the actual new charge.
Files were captured once during a running evaluation; later request/cost snapshots can advance during report construction.
